top_paper.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
top_paper.summary: WeVisOne-VL unifies object-level and pixel-level visual perception via structured token prediction, supporting detection, localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting with a lightweight pixel decoder and multi-stage training.

papers.title: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
papers.summary: TARSphere is a robot framework that integrates physics simulation, embodied NPCs, and a frozen multimodal language model to evaluate long-horizon embodied agents across diverse indoor tasks and social conditions.

papers.title: The LLM-Attacker: A Unified Red-Team Framework for Privacy Evaluation of Split and Distributed LLM Systems
papers.summary: LLM-Attacker standardizes privacy evaluations for split language models by recording attacker configurations, enabling comparable scoring of reconstruction attacks, and requiring linked undefended baselines for defense claims.

papers.title: EvalResearchBench: Can AI Agents Build Their Own Feedback for Recursive Self-Improvement?
papers.summary: AI agents can automate benchmark design to reduce evaluation costs, but their generated evaluators still fall short of target agreement and suffer from budget exhaustion and score dominance issues.

papers.title: Diffusion Language Models Change Speed Across Tasks and Languages
papers.summary: Diffusion language models spend more computation on novel, rare, or incorrect outputs, and decoding speed can improve inference efficiency and reliability.

papers.title: Different Tasks, Different Timesteps: Temporal Task-Aware Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: T2Quant improves diffusion language model quantization by dynamically allocating activation precision across denoising steps based on predicted task- and time-dependent sensitivity.

papers.title: Bridging Exploration and Persona: Information-Directed Dueling for Test-Time Agent Personalization
papers.summary: ID-TAP uses a neural dueling-bandit framework with similarity-weighted warm starts to adapt LLM agents to user preferences via binary response comparisons within a limited interaction budget.

papers.title: IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.summary: IF-MAP identifies high-impact agents in multi-agent LLM systems via prompt perturbation analysis to maximize system-level gains from targeted improvements.

papers.title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
papers.summary: LLM agents frequently leak sensitive conclusions assembled from multiple confidential documents, and common safeguards fail to eliminate this mosaic-style disclosure risk.

papers.title: HyperDrone: Simulation-to-Reality Transfer at Millions of Frames per Second
papers.summary: HyperDrone is a GPU-accelerated quadrotor simulator using a ray-tracing engine to render high-fidelity observations at high speed, enabling vision-based policy training and real-world transfer.

papers.title: BrickWright: Agentic Creation of Physically Feasible Brick Builds
papers.summary: BrickWright improves physical validity of AI-generated LEGO assemblies by providing agents with an assembly API and feasibility validator, achieving perfect validity while preserving prompt adherence.

papers.title: Who Takes the Lead? Model Ability and Task-Conditioned Collaboration with Humans
papers.summary: Researchers use a shared-control maze to show that stronger language-model agents selectively involve humans based on route advantage rather than failing to collaborate.

papers.title: FilmFlow: Agentic System for 3D Virtual Film Cinematography
papers.summary: FilmFlow is an agentic framework that translates natural-language or video instructions into executable camera trajectories for 3D scenes using specialized director, interpreter, scout, and critic agents, evaluated on the CinemaBench dataset.

papers.title: RIDAR: Safeguarding Research Integrity in Autonomous Research Agents via Automated Detection and Runtime Intervention
papers.summary: RIDAR detects and mitigates research integrity violations in autonomous agents via taxonomy-based post-hoc analysis and real-time intervention.

papers.title: Realism VS Accuracy: Event Sequence Forecasting from a Generative Modeling Perspective
papers.summary: Event sequence forecasting is evaluated as conditional generative modeling, revealing a trade-off between accuracy and realism, and a proposed algorithm converts realism into predictive accuracy.

papers.title: MambaAct: Efficient Mamba Action Experts for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary: MambaAct replaces the transformer action expert in flow-matching VLA policies with a compact Mamba-based expert and a context compressor to cut inference latency while improving robotic manipulation success.

papers.title: SplatLab: Autonomous Scientific Discovery for 3DGS Research
papers.summary: SplatLab autonomously reproduces 3D Gaussian Splatting baselines, proposes extensions, and writes manuscripts with fully traceable training logs, improving PSNR by up to 3.78 dB.

papers.title: RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation
papers.summary: RTAformer separately models persistent entities and changing relations in video scene graphs by injecting calibrated query differences and aligning cross-frame instances to overcome relational semantic inertia.

papers.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
papers.summary: IQuest-Q1 is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts foundation model trained via multi-stage pre-training, mid-training, and post-training to achieve strong agentic coding and general capabilities.

papers.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
papers.summary: WeVisOne-VL unifies object-level and pixel-level visual perception via structured token prediction, supporting detection, localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting with a lightweight pixel decoder and multi-stage training.

papers.title: What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
papers.summary: GAFU leverages native generation-side representations to improve fine-grained visual understanding in unified multimodal models by compressing them into compact tokens for task-conditioned retrieval.

papers.title: What Makes a Good Unmasking Policy? A Controlled Study of Learned Unmasking in Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: Optimized unmasking policies for masked diffusion language models improve efficiency by using trajectory-contraction targets with confidence and hidden states, achieving better speed-accuracy trade-offs with minimal overhead.

papers.title: RLSplat: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.summary: RLSplat enables feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting with linear reductions in latency, memory, and model size by allocating Gaussians regionally and decoding them via local attention.

papers.title: TILDE: Teacher-in-the-Loop Distillation from Embodied Foundation Models
papers.summary: TILDE distills embodied foundation model capabilities into robot policies via on-policy teacher supervision and autonomous recovery data collection, improving real-world task performance without large-scale action pretraining.

papers.title: RouteWeaver: Weaving Mode Selection and Execution into Unified LLM Routing
papers.summary: RouteWeaver unifies heterogeneous LLM routing modes via coordinated training and progressive exploration, improving accuracy across diverse reasoning tasks.

papers.title: Heartbeat Thinking: Speculative Reasoning and Tool Execution While Listening in Realtime Voice Agents
papers.summary: A heartbeat-style speculative reasoning approach lets voice agents continue preparing tool calls during speech updates, improving coverage and reducing response latency.

papers.title: Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation
papers.summary: LayerEditor unifies instruction-guided image editing with reusable RGBA layer generation via joint token modeling and edit-prior distillation, enabling precise local manipulation and layer reuse.

papers.title: F2G-Pose: Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting for Direct RGB-D Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
papers.summary: F2G-Pose is a real-time feed-forward framework that predicts category-level object pose, metric size, and completed shape from a single RGB-D image using dense visual features, DGCNN tokenization, and a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer.

papers.title: Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models
papers.summary: FRED improves single-step future video representations in world action models through self-distillation and temporal conditioning, boosting robot policy performance on long-horizon and unseen tasks.

papers.title: AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark
papers.summary: AnyGameRenderer is a video-to-video generative model that transforms low-quality agent-built game footage into high-fidelity visuals while preserving layout, camera, and entity timing.

papers.title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
papers.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operating conditions and potentially irreversible consequences.
